policy: PREREGISTER BEFORE MEASUREMENT; NO TRACKING UNTIL PRIVACY APPROVAL

definitions.qualified_lead: A human-confirmed request containing a feasible service type, site, contact channel, and plausible timing; deduplicated by CRM lead ID.
definitions.denominator: eligible human sessions when privacy-approved analytics exists; otherwise do not report conversion rate

candidates.hypothesis: An object-first industrial headline increases the fraction of technically qualified leads compared with the old generic headline.
candidates.assignment: stable client-side randomization only after approved measurement and baseline
candidates.stop_rule: predefined evaluation window and power calculation required; never choose winner from raw click uplift

candidates.hypothesis: Making historical calculator rates explicit reduces misleading price expectations while preserving the share of viable inquiries.
candidates.assignment: pre-register; if low traffic use moderated task study instead of false statistical confidence
candidates.stop_rule: No declaration of benefit without outcome evidence

data_governance.crm_contract: Do not modify /api/v1/site/leads or PBT signature; join outcomes inside authorized CRM only.
data_governance.privacy: No analytics, session recording, fingerprinting or third-party tags in this PR.
data_governance.causality: Trends are associations absent randomized holdout; do not publish uplift.
